title: Bacterial and Fungal DNA Extraction Protocol for Long-Read Whole Genome Sequencing
author: Manon Norest
materials: Fungal growth Place a fungal stab (obtained from the culture collection tube stored at 4°C) on four Inhibitory Mold Agar plates. Collect the mycelium from the four plates into a 5ml Eppendorf tube and incubate it at -80°C for 24h. Lyophilize the mycelium for 48h at -55°C. In this study we utilized the Heto PowerDry LL3000 freezedryer of ThermoScientific.

steps.title: Prepare tubes and lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Fill each 2 mL Eppendorf tube with 0.5 mL 1 mm glass beads and pre‑heat the lysis buffer for at least 30 min at 65 °C before use.

steps.title: Grow bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Choose solid or liquid growth: for solid, streak the -80 °C stock onto Nutrient Agar plates containing CaCl₂ and incubate at the appropriate temperature; for liquid, inoculate a single colony into 10 mL Nutrient Broth, incubate at the appropriate temperature with shaking at 120 rpm until stationary phase.

steps.title: Harvest bacterial cells
steps.instruction: If grown in broth, centrifuge the culture at 5 000 g for 10 min, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 800 µL pre‑heated lysis buffer by vigorous pipetting; if grown on agar, pick colonies equivalent to two toothpick tips and mix directly into 800 µL pre‑heated lysis buffer.

steps.title: Prepare fungal material
steps.instruction: Weigh 30 mg dried mycelium into a 2 mL tube containing the glass beads, add 800 µL pre‑heated lysis buffer (for strains requiring multiple tubes, process separately and later pool the DNA).

steps.title: Cell lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Place the tube (bacterial suspension or fungal material) in a Tissue Lyser at 6 m/s for 1 min, then incubate at 65 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Add common lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of 20 % SDS stock, homogenize again in the Tissue Lyser at 6 m/s for 1 min, add 20 µL lysozyme (100 mg/mL) and incubate 30 min at 37 °C, then add 8 µL proteinase K and incubate overnight at 56 °C.

steps.title: Initial centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 1 min at 10 000 × g.

steps.title: Potassium acetate precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer ~650 µL supernatant to a new tube containing 200 µL 5 M potassium acetate, mix and incubate on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 2 min and transfer the resulting ~500 µL supernatant to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), invert repeatedly until homogeneous, then centrifuge 5 min at maximum speed.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase (~300 µL) to a new tube without disturbing the interphase; if traces of microbial material are present, repeat the chloroform:isoamyl alcohol step twice more.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of isopropanol and 1/8 volume of 3 M sodium acetate, mix, and incubate on ice for 10 min.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 min, discard supernatant by inverting the tube, and let the pellet dry for 5 min under the hood.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 5 min at maximum speed, discard supernatant, and dry the pellet for 5 min under the hood.

steps.title: Bead‑based purification
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL Elution Buffer, add 900 µL beads buffer, incubate on a rotator at 10 rpm for 45 min at room temperature, spin down 1 s, place on a magnetic rack for 5 min until the solution clears, discard supernatant, add 70 % ethanol to fully immerse beads, flick to resuspend, spin down, return to magnetic rack and remove ethanol; repeat the ethanol‑wash step once more, then air‑dry beads on the magnetic rack for 5 min (avoid over‑drying).

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Elution Buffer, gently pipette to resuspend beads, spin down 1 s, incubate 15 min at 37 °C, spin down 1 s, place on magnetic rack until solution clears, and transfer the eluate (high‑molecular‑weight DNA) to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase A (100 mg/mL) to the eluate and incubate at 50 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: DNA quantification and quality check
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with NanoDrop or Qubit; verify 260/280 ratio (1.8–2.0) and 260/230 ratio (2.0–2.2). Assess integrity by running 1.5 % agarose gel with a 100 bp ladder.
